text:
maria: noticed a spike in 502/504s hitting hosted inference after yesterday's rollout of kernel-selector-v2 at ~10:12 PDT. support tickets coming in. sample request ids: r_8f12, r_8f14. canary at 25% currently :warning:

jordan: customers reporting timeouts and gateway 502s when sending long-context prompts (8k+). one enterprise acct saw 30% failure rate from 10:15–10:40.

sam: @maria any quick repro? can you point to a failing request payload?

maria: reproducer attached inline. if you send a 12k prompt to model=redwood-4-quant with session cache enabled, the backend returns a truncated stream and gateway responds with 502. logs show RPC "DecodeResponse" -> connection closed.

maria: ```
ERROR runtime/stream.go:223 decode failed: kv-cache-format-mismatch: expected format v1, got v2
WARN router/proxy.go:112 returning gateway 502 to client after worker disconnect
```

ops-oncall: deploy-bot reports the canary step progressed earlier: "canary kernel-selector-v2 -> 25% -> 50%" at 10:13 then 10:14.

deploy-bot: canary rollout id=krnl-2026-05, target=redwood-runtime, phase=CANARY, percent=50, status=IN_PROGRESS

kyle: is kernel-selector-v2 supposed to switch quantized model paths? if it routes some models to a new execution path that expects a different KV cache layout we could see this.

maria: yes. kernel-selector-v2 changes the kernel selection heuristics and switches some quantized models to the new fast-path. it should be compatible, but looks like the kv-cache encoder version bumped and we didn't gate it with model metadata.

sam: can we abort or rollback the canary? we should freeze traffic to v1 until we confirm compatibility.

maria: starting rollback to kernel-selector-v1 now. running: ``kubectl -n runtime rollout undo rs/redwood-runtime-krnl-2026-05 --to-revision=1``

maria: rollback started. rolling back canary traffic to 0% for krnl-2026-05 :white_check_mark:

ops-oncall: confirmed rollback triggered via deploy service, traffic shifting back to kernel-selector-v1.

jordan: support: customer affected (acct: big-retailer) confirmed errors dropped from 32% -> 1% 10 minutes after rollback. they're asking for root cause writeup.

sam: root cause hypothesis: kernel-selector-v2 introduced a KV cache serialization version bump for quantized fast-path. router/proxy doesn't validate compatibility and treats worker disconnect as a hard failure -> gateway 502. batching logic retries but client sees 502/timeouts.

maria: agreed. repro notes:
- send long-context (>=8k) to redwood-4-quant with session cache on
- observe worker log: "kv-cache-format-mismatch"
- gateway returns 502 after worker process exits

maria: mitigation steps (done):
- rollback canary to v1 (done)
- temporary gating: add model-metadata flag to kernel-selector to exclude quantized models from v2
- open CR to add compatibility check in router/proxy to detect kv-cache version mismatch and fallback instead of close connection

kyle: owners? maria for runtime fix, sam for gateway fallback, eng-ml to coordinate model-metadata update. jordan to follow-up with customers and update tickets.

jordan: will update support thread and post incident status page entry. cc: @customers who reported.

maria: creating postmortem draft and assigning tasks. quick follow-up request: please add any customer repro payloads to the incident thread.

sam: +1. I'll add an urgent test to our CI that validates runtime path compatibility for quantized models across kernel versions.

ops-oncall: monitoring shows error rate back to baseline after rollback. keeping this channel open for 2h post-rollback. :lock:

jordan: closing customer-facing bridge after updates. thanks everyone. :rocket:
